subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact home-path display by default, switch agent-visible path output to full absolute paths, or add an explicit full-path mode?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally shorten home-contained paths, related fixes preserved that behavior, and the requested change affects display defaults, privacy posture, docs, and possible config surface.

options.title: Keep compact default
options.body: Preserve the current `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` display contract while continuing to fix corrupt or non-copyable path rewrites.

options.title: Switch default to full paths
options.body: Make agent-visible path output use full absolute paths everywhere and update prompts, helpers, docs, and regression tests consistently.

options.title: Add explicit full-path mode
options.body: Keep the compact default but add a documented opt-in for users who need full path output in responses and tool displays.

recommendation.title: Keep compact default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` display contract while continuing to fix corrupt or non-copyable path rewrites.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the central helper and tool-display metadata that define the current path-display contract.
